set.body:
Objective
Make a_08_simulation.Rmd scientifically correct and ensure its comparisons isolate the factor they claim to vary.

Required work
- Correct the respiratory and cardiac labels and address frequencies above the TR=2 Nyquist limit.
- Either generate physiology on a high-resolution clock before sampling and teach aliasing explicitly, or choose clearly labeled sub-Nyquist toy components.
- Build SNR panels from shared onsets, conditions, clean signal, and base noise realization so only SNR changes.
- Put the high-resolution drift spectrum in the intended comparison panel.
- Replace the stale Next text with a real article link.

Acceptance criteria
- The sampled physiological components are not accidentally identical unless the vignette intentionally demonstrates and explains that alias.
- Tests verify shared event structure and clean signal across SNR conditions.
- An assertion or diagnostic confirms the intended SNR ordering.
- Figure facets and captions agree.
- The full vignette rerenders with all scientific descriptions matching output.
set.title: Correct physiological aliasing and controlled-SNR demonstrations
